card.title: PS5 Blue Light of Death (BLOD) and Thermal Diagnostics

claims.statement: Pulsating blue light of death indicates the system is continuously running hardware checks due to an unresolved fault.
claims.quote: Is keeps pulsating because it keeps running checks. Blue light and after 2 second it turns off is a common error of PS5.

claims.statement: Unexplained BLOD requires thermal camera inspection for hot spots and diode mode probing for shorts on power rails.
claims.evidence: Recommended diagnostic workflow for generic blue light failures.
claims.quote: Check board with thermal camera to check for shorts. Problem could be anything... Probe board in diode mode to find shorts.

procedure: Check for liquid metal spills on the board and under APU seals.
Probe board power rails in diode mode for shorts.
Scan board with a thermal camera to identify abnormal heat dissipation.
card.caveats: BLOD is a generic symptom that can originate from almost any subsystem.
